locale_evidence.rule: Every locale must have accepted review evidence before its corpus cases can be evaluated. Missing, extra, draft, or cross-locale fallback evidence is rejected.

chunk_manifest.rule: A chunk without the required schema version, deterministic ID, locale, version, provenance, source hash, or manifest hash is unversioned or unverifiable and is rejected before embedding or retrieval.

committed_source: reviewed eligible DITA and provenance records
selected configuration, tools, compact synthetic fixtures, and tests
generated_ignored: model downloads, caches, benchmark reports, and conversation state
artifact_ownership.rule: No generated artifact is hand-edited or treated as source; a model/index/chunk candidate activates only as a complete checksummed compatible manifest set.

resource_ceilings.rule: An implementation must reject or cancel work before exceeding these ceilings; a limit breach cannot start another worker or block lexical search.

startup_and_network.rule: A plan that starts a model, opens network access, or exposes a listener without all required explicit conditions is rejected.

forbidden_capabilities: arbitrary URL selection or network access
function calling, plugins, MCP, or code interpreter
capability_boundary.rule: The local assistant has no callable tool capability. A missing or non-empty tool allowlist is rejected.

answer.rule: An answer needs at least one current resolved citation. Local citations must resolve to the activated published manifest; external citations must be explicitly labelled and cannot replace local evidence.

clarify.rule: A clarification asks only for the missing BPM documentation context and does not invent evidence.

abstain.rule: No-evidence cases abstain without a fabricated citation or web call.

refuse.rule: Off-topic or unsafe requests refuse before retrieval, inference, or web access.

state_and_fallback.rule: Unknown state, unsupported transition, false readiness, or an AI dependency in lexical search is rejected.
